story.title: Snabbit Raises $56M in Six Months After Last Round as Instant Home Services Race Intensifies in India
story.summary: On-demand home services startup Snabbit has raised $56 million in a new round co-led by Susquehanna Venture Capital, Mirae Asset Venture Investments, and Bertelsmann India Investments, bringing its total capital raised to $112 million in under a year. The rapid successive fundraising reflects intensifying investor interest in India's instant home services category, where Snabbit competes to connect urban households with vetted domestic help on short notice. The company plans to use the capital to expand city coverage and deepen its service category range.
